Bringing together AI music producers, technology enthusiasts, and music lovers, the event showcases the best AI-assisted South African tracks in a high-energy nightclub atmosphere where audiences discover new artists, vote live for their favourites, and experience the intersection of music, technology, and culture.
projects.title: Prompt Party
projects.details:
Prompt Party: AI Club Night is an innovative live music experience created by BLKSM Events that reimagines the traditional nightclub by placing artificial intelligence at the heart of the entertainment. Designed to showcase the growing world of AI-assisted music production, the event provides a professional platform where emerging and established creators can present their original AI-produced tracks to a live audience in an immersive club environment. Its mission is to create a high-energy space where technology meets South African music culture on the dancefloor.

Before the event, producers submit their original AI-generated or AI-assisted tracks across multiple genres, including Amapiano, Afro House, Gqom, Hip-Hop, Trap, EDM, Techno and Experimental music. Following a structured curation process, the strongest submissions are selected and organised into genre-based showcase sessions, ensuring a seamless musical journey throughout the evening.

On event day, guests enjoy an immersive nightlife experience featuring professional sound production, AI-generated visual displays, futuristic décor, live DJs, interactive hosts, and continuous music from start to finish. Throughout the night, audiences participate by voting in real time via QR codes, with live leaderboards displaying results as tracks compete for recognition in multiple award categories. Interactive activations such as Producer Spotlights, Guess the Genre, and the Prompt Wall further connect attendees with the artists and encourage audience participation.

The evening concludes with an exciting awards ceremony celebrating excellence in AI music production, recognising outstanding performances across multiple genres while crowning the overall Crowd Favourite. More than just a music event, Prompt Party serves as a platform for innovation, collaboration, and creative discovery, bringing together artists, technology, and audiences to demonstrate how artificial intelligence is transforming the future of music. It is designed to become a flagship event that grows South Africa's AI music community while delivering an unforgettable entertainment experience unlike anything currently available in the local nightlife industry.

projects.title: Jäger Bingo
projects.summary: Jäger Bingo is a high-energy social entertainment experience that transforms the traditional game of Bingo into an unforgettable Afrikaner party night. Combining the excitement of interactive gameplay with Jägermeister, live DJs, local humour, cultural traditions, audience participation, and premium prizes, the event delivers a unique celebration where every game becomes an immersive social experience. Designed as both a branded entertainment platform and a community event, Jäger Bingo creates an atmosphere where people come together to laugh, compete, celebrate, and make lasting memories.
projects.details:
Jäger Bingo is an innovative live entertainment concept that reinvents the classic game of Bingo into South Africa's ultimate Afrikaner party experience. Built around the energy and heritage of Jägermeister, the event blends interactive gameplay with music, culture, comedy, food, and social interaction to create an evening that is as much about the atmosphere as it is about winning.

Guests receive custom-designed Jäger Bingo cards featuring a mix of Afrikaner icons, traditions, slang, food, and Jägermeister-themed moments instead of traditional numbers. Guided by an energetic MC and supported by a live DJ, players compete through multiple exciting rounds while enjoying Jäger shots, crowd challenges, cultural games, and spontaneous entertainment that keeps the energy high from the first call to the final prize.

Throughout the evening, guests experience themed activations including Jäger toasts, interactive audience challenges, cultural storytelling, humour, and live music, all carefully designed to celebrate Afrikaner culture in a modern, inclusive, and entertaining way. Premium Jägermeister branding is integrated throughout the venue with dedicated shot stations, signature cocktails, branded décor, and immersive visual elements that transform the venue into a fully themed party destination.

Each round offers exciting prizes ranging from exclusive Jäger merchandise and branded experiences to VIP rewards, ensuring continuous excitement and participation throughout the event. Beyond the game itself, Jäger Bingo is designed as a scalable entertainment brand capable of touring venues, festivals, private functions, corporate events, and hospitality destinations across South Africa.

More than simply a game night, Jäger Bingo is a complete live entertainment experience that combines competition, music, culture, and premium brand engagement into one unforgettable event. By bringing communities together through laughter, celebration, and shared experiences, it creates a distinctive entertainment format that is highly engaging for guests while providing exceptional value for venues, sponsors, and brand partners alike.

projects.title: AI Dance Night
projects.summary: AI Dance Night is a groundbreaking live entertainment experience that transforms AI-generated music into a premium nightclub event. Featuring the winning creators from Prompt Party, the evening showcases original AI-produced music across multiple genres, immersive visuals, audience interaction, and high-energy performances, creating an unforgettable celebration of creativity, technology, and the future of music.
projects.details:
AI Dance Night is the natural evolution of Prompt Party, transforming South Africa's emerging AI music creators from competition winners into live performers. Rather than simply showcasing technology, the event celebrates the artists behind the prompts by placing them centre stage in a professionally produced nightclub experience where audiences can discover, dance to, and engage with entirely original AI-created music. It represents the next chapter in building a vibrant AI music community and positions Pretoria as a leader in innovative live entertainment.

The event features seven AI music creators, each representing a unique musical genre, including EDM, Afro House, Rock, Country, Afrikaans Dance, Pop, and a Wildcard performance, allowing guests to experience a diverse musical journey throughout the evening. Every artist performs a dedicated live set supported by custom branding, AI-generated visual backdrops, genre-specific lighting, live visualisers, and QR codes that allow guests to instantly discover and follow each creator's music beyond the event.

More than a traditional music event, AI Dance Night is designed to be highly interactive. Between performances, audiences take part in experiences such as the AI vs Human Challenge, where guests attempt to identify whether a music clip was created by a human or artificial intelligence, and Prompt Roulette, where audience-submitted prompts are transformed into original songs live on stage before the crowd votes for their favourites. These interactive moments ensure that every guest becomes part of the experience rather than simply watching from the sidelines.

Built to the standards of a premium live production rather than a conventional club night, AI Dance Night combines professional staging, immersive visuals, dynamic lighting, interactive hosting, and original music into a seamless entertainment experience unlike anything currently available in South Africa. It is designed not only as a successful standalone event but as the second step in a broader ecosystem that begins with Prompt Party, grows through AI creator workshops, and culminates in annual AI Music Awards, creating a sustainable platform that nurtures talent, grows audiences, and establishes a lasting AI music movement.

projects.title: Flashmob
projects.summary: A high-energy, surprise flashmob activation designed to captivate shoppers and create an unforgettable live entertainment experience. The performance begins with subtle moments of curiosity as a drummer starts playing, followed by a child triggering the music, before a lead artist unexpectedly emerges from a store. One by one, musicians and dancers join the performance, transforming an ordinary shopping day into a vibrant celebration of music, dance, and community interaction. The activation concludes after two dynamic songs, leaving audiences entertained and creating strong opportunities for social media engagement and brand exposure.
projects.details:
The Flashmob Kolonnade is a carefully choreographed live entertainment activation created to surprise, engage, and delight shoppers through an unexpected musical performance. Designed to appear spontaneous while being precisely coordinated behind the scenes, the activation combines live music, dance, audience participation, and theatrical storytelling to create a memorable experience that encourages social sharing and enhances the atmosphere within the shopping centre.

The event begins with an extensive preparation phase where the production team conducts equipment checks, operational briefings, location verification, and final confirmations with all performers and third-party stakeholders. This ensures every participant understands their timing and responsibilities before the live activation commences.

At exactly the scheduled performance time, a lone drummer begins playing, drawing the attention of nearby shoppers and creating intrigue. Moments later, a child seemingly triggers the performance by pressing play on a tablet, giving the illusion that the entire event has begun organically. The lead performer then unexpectedly exits one of the stores, collecting a guitar and microphone from unsuspecting members of the public before launching into the performance.

As the music builds, additional musicians gradually emerge from surrounding shops, followed by dancers appearing from multiple locations throughout the mall. The performers seamlessly unite into a full-scale flashmob, filling the space with energy and excitement while inviting shoppers to join the celebration. Audience members are encouraged to dance, record the moment, and become part of the experience, creating authentic engagement and highly shareable content.

The performance consists of two energetic musical numbers that build momentum before concluding with the performers naturally dispersing back into the shopping centre, restoring the environment to normal as though nothing unusual had happened. The activation leaves visitors with a memorable experience, strengthens the shopping centre's reputation as a destination for exciting entertainment, and generates valuable organic exposure through photographs, videos, and social media sharing.

projects.title: TikBox 9
projects.summary: TikBox 9 was a high-energy creator boxing event that successfully united influencers, athletes, sponsors, and spectators for an unforgettable live experience. Organized by BLKSM Events, the event blended competitive boxing with entertainment, creating an engaging platform that celebrated resilience, sportsmanship, and community. Beyond the action in the ring, TikBox 9 emphasized collaboration, mental health awareness, and the growing influence of digital creators, while delivering a professionally executed production that strengthened the TikBox brand and laid the foundation for future events.
projects.details:
TikBox 9 was a landmark creator boxing event that successfully brought together digital creators, athletes, influencers, sponsors, partners, and spectators for an unforgettable evening of live entertainment and sporting excellence. Produced and managed by BLKSM Events, the event showcased the evolution of creator-led entertainment by combining professionally organized boxing matches with immersive audience experiences, premium event production, and engaging live entertainment. The result was an energetic atmosphere that captivated attendees from the opening bout through to the final match, reinforcing TikBox as one of South Africa's most exciting creator-driven sporting events.

More than a boxing event, TikBox 9 served as a platform that celebrated courage, discipline, resilience, and personal growth. Participants stepped outside their comfort zones, dedicating weeks of preparation and training to compete in front of a live audience. Their journeys inspired supporters and demonstrated the values of commitment, sportsmanship, and determination, while creating authentic stories that resonated across both the venue and digital platforms.

The event also fostered meaningful collaboration between creators, brands, sponsors, media partners, and the wider community. Through strategic partnerships and high-quality production, TikBox 9 provided sponsors with valuable brand exposure, extensive audience engagement, and opportunities to connect with an enthusiastic and diverse demographic. The integration of live entertainment, influencer participation, and digital content creation ensured that the event's impact extended well beyond fight night, generating significant online conversation and continued visibility across social media channels.

A key pillar of TikBox 9 was its commitment to promoting mental health awareness and encouraging positive conversations around personal wellbeing. By highlighting stories of perseverance, transformation, and overcoming adversity, the event demonstrated how sport and community can inspire confidence, strengthen connections, and create lasting positive impact. This purpose-driven approach added depth to the event while reinforcing its broader social value.

From event planning and logistics to technical production, athlete coordination, audience management, branding, and stakeholder engagement, TikBox 9 reflected the professionalism and operational excellence of BLKSM Events. The seamless execution, positive attendee experience, and overwhelmingly enthusiastic response from participants, sponsors, and spectators further strengthened the TikBox brand, established new benchmarks for future events, and positioned the platform for continued growth within South Africa's creator economy and live entertainment industry.
